   Old way: alarm clock (cron)         New way: a to-do line (ledger-scheduler queue)
        ⏰ ──► 🧑‍🔧                           📋📋📋 ──► 🧑‍🔧
                                           ◄── recommended direction (judgment call)

   and add a "do not disturb" sign
   (a lockfile) so two workers never
   run at once.
